content.value_statement: Teams need accurate AI help for Lark Docs without manual command lookup. This skill guides authenticated reading, editing, media, history, and routing workflows.
actual_capabilities: Fetch Lark Docx or Wiki content from a URL or token.
Create documents from XML or Markdown content.
Update documents with replacement, insertion, deletion, movement, or overwrite operations.
Insert, preview, download, update, or delete supported document media resources.
List and revert document history when users request rollback.
Detect embedded sheets, Base tables, notes, whiteboards, and route work to matching skills.
limitations: Requires lark-cli and Lark authentication before use.
Cannot manage document comments; it routes those tasks to Lark Drive.
Does not edit spreadsheet or Base data inside embedded resources.
Write actions depend on user permissions and should be confirmed before execution.

use_cases.title: Review a Shared Document
use_cases.description: Fetch a Lark Doc section, summarize decisions, and keep source structure clear.

use_cases.title: Publish Team Content
use_cases.description: Create a formatted Lark Doc from approved XML or Markdown content.

use_cases.title: Maintain Document Assets
use_cases.description: Insert images, download media, update covers, or inspect embedded resources.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch this Lark document and summarize the main decisions: <doc URL>.

prompt_templates.title: Create a New Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new Lark Doc with this title and outline: <title>, <outline>.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Specific Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the section named <section> in this document with this revised text: <doc URL>, <text>.

prompt_templates.title: Route Embedded Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Lark Doc, identify embedded sheets or boards, route tokens, and report findings.

output_examples.input: Summarize this Lark document from its URL.
output_examples.output: A concise summary with important headings, decisions, and follow-up items.

output_examples.input: Insert this approved image into the document.
output_examples.output: The document is updated with the image at the requested location and a short confirmation.

output_examples.input: Restore the document to a known revision.
output_examples.output: The matching revision is identified, confirmation is requested, and rollback status is reported.

best_practices: Fetch only the needed section before targeted edits.
Confirm user intent before writes, deletes, downloads, or rollbacks.
Use XML for precise block edits unless the user requests Markdown.
anti_patterns: Do not rebuild a document when a copy operation is needed.
Do not reuse old block IDs after replace, delete, or overwrite actions.
Do not guess local file paths after clipboard upload fails.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Lark Docx and Wiki document reading, creation, editing, media, and history workflows.

faq.question: Does it require a Lark account?
faq.answer: Yes. Users need lark-cli authentication and permissions for the target document.

faq.question: Can it edit embedded sheets or Base tables?
faq.answer: No. It extracts tokens and routes those tasks to the matching Lark skill.

faq.question: Can it manage comments?
faq.answer: No. Comment tasks are outside this skill and should use Lark Drive workflows.

faq.question: How does it handle precise edits?
faq.answer: It fetches relevant block IDs and uses XML-based update commands for controlled changes.

faq.question: Can it download document images?
faq.answer: Yes. It can preview or download supported media when the user requests that action.
